breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated sign convention by redefining positive shear and bending moment after already specifying upward shear on the left cut face and sagging as positive.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly adopts the contradictory sign convention from the incomplete prompt: 'Use positive shear downward on the left cut face' and 'Use positive bending moment as hogging with tension at top fibers.' The ground truth removes this contradictory redefinition entirely, keeping only the original convention of upward shear on the left cut face and sagging (tension at bottom) as positive. The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency and instead repeated the erroneous reversed sign convention.
